shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git ls-files | head -50

for f in index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; echo "=== agent_eval"; ls -R __agent_eval__ | head; echo "=== uikit version"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | grep -i theme

d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme; ls $d; echo ======; cat $d/ThemeProvider.js; echo ======; cat $d/ThemeProvider.d.ts; echo ======; cat $d/index.d.ts; echo ======; cat $d/useTheme.js $d/useThemeValue.js $d/useThemeType.js 2>/dev/null; echo ======; cat $d/constants.js $d/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo; echo === run.mjs; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80

grep -o '\.g-root{[^}]*}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -3; grep -o 'body{[^}]*}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "icons present: $(grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json)"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -iE '^(Sun|Moon|Display)' ; grep -n 'SegmentedRadioGroup\|export \* from "./Switch\|export \* from "./Button' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useSystemTheme.js

ls node_modules | grep -iE '^(jsdom|happy-dom|playwright|puppeteer)$'; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/dom-helpers.js

sed -i \
  -e "s#^import { ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';#import { AppThemeProvider } from './theme';#" \
  -e 's#<ThemeProvider theme="light">#<AppThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">#' \
  -e 's#</ThemeProvider>#</AppThemeProvider>#' src/main.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json && grep -n 'peerDependencies' -A4 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep icons

sed -i '1,2c\// Preconfigured Gravity UI setup is wired here (both CSS imports + theme provider).\n// AppThemeProvider wraps uikit ThemeProvider and persists the chosen theme in localStorage (see theme.tsx).' src/main.tsx && head -3 src/main.tsx && (npm install --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund @gravity-ui/icons@2.23.0 2>&1 | tail -5) && grep -n 'icons' package.json
sed -i 's# qa={`theme-switcher-${value}`}##' src/ThemeSwitcher.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -3 && git status --short
rm -rf dist && echo 'dist/' >> .gitignore && cat .gitignore && git status --short
